classification.difficultyReason: Combines angle sums, exterior and reflex angles, parallel lines, kite and isosceles-triangle properties, and linear equations.

content.prompt: Determine the value of these pronumerals using your angle relationships knowledge.

spec.description: Concave quadrilateral with a narrow upper vertex and a smaller exterior angle at the inward right vertex.
spec.mathematics: Interior givens 40°, 85° and 27°; a° is the smaller exterior angle at the concave vertex.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens and unknown only; supplied answer excluded.

answer.worked:
The reflex interior angle is $360^{\circ}-a$.
$$\begin{align*}40+85+27+(360-a)&=360 &&\text{(angle sum of a quadrilateral)}\\512-a&=360\\a&=152^{\circ}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Quadrilateral with the left-to-upper side extended beyond its upper vertex.
spec.mathematics: 62°, 97°, a right angle and exterior angle a° at the upper vertex.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens and unknown only; supplied answer excluded.

answer.worked:
Let $t$ be the upper interior angle.
$$\begin{align*}t+62+97+90&=360 &&\text{(angle sum of a quadrilateral)}\\t+249&=360\\t&=111^{\circ}\\a+111&=180 &&\text{(angles on a straight line)}\\a&=69^{\circ}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Parallelogram with the top edge extended right and the right edge extended upward.
spec.mathematics: Matching single horizontal parallel arrows, matching double sloping parallel arrows, 106° upper-left interior angle and a° between the upper-right extensions.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens and unknown only; supplied answer excluded.

answer.worked:
Let $t$ be the upper-right interior angle.
$$\begin{align*}t+106&=180 &&\text{(co-interior angles)}\\t&=74^{\circ}\\a&=74^{\circ} &&\text{(vertically opposite angles)}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upright kite, short upper pair and long lower pair.
spec.mathematics: Single equality ticks on the upper sides, double equality ticks on the lower sides; left angle 95°, right angle (5x)°.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens and unknown only; supplied answer excluded.

answer.worked:
The opposite angles between the unequal sides of a kite are equal.
$$\begin{align*}5x&=95\\x&=19\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Linked lower-left isosceles triangle and upper-right right triangle sharing the intersection of a horizontal line and a rising diagonal.
spec.mathematics: Upper-right triangle angles 5b, 4b and 90°; c is above-left at the intersection. Lower-left triangle has equal horizontal and diagonal sides, and lower angle d.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens and unknowns only; supplied answers excluded.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}5b+4b+90&=180 &&\text{(angle sum of a triangle)}\\9b&=90\\b&=10\\c+50&=180 &&\text{(angles on a straight line)}\\c&=130^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
The lower-left triangle's angle at the intersection is $50^{\circ}$ (vertically opposite angles). Its two base angles are equal (isosceles triangle).
$$\begin{align*}d+d+50&=180\\2d&=130\\d&=65^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
